description: Versioned provisional weights for ordering source-backed career hypotheses. Not a probability, aptitude score, validated psychometric measure, or prediction of career success.
active_component_normalization: Only components with usable input evidence contribute to ordering; absent input components are omitted and the remaining weights are renormalized. A non-match is not evidence of low ability or potential.

high_requires: at least 6 profile observations relevant to the candidate
at least 3 distinct challenge families or user-provided project/portfolio records
at least 2 evidence source kinds or signal dimensions
relevant evidence within the last 90 days
no unresolved student-reported contradiction in the relevant evidence window
at least one reviewed or verified career source reference
confidence_policy.note: Evidence confidence describes the quantity, diversity, recency, consistency and provenance of the available support. It is not confidence that the person will succeed in the career.
